ui_bugs.issue: Summary table rows are sorted OLDEST-first (I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII) instead of LATEST-first as required. The detail cards below the table are correctly latest-first (VII, VI, V, IV, III, II, I). Bug is in the inline .sort() comparator on the summary card: it uses `ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester)`. Since ROMAN_ORDER = [VIII, VII, ..., I] (lower index = newer), latest-first needs `indexOf(a) - indexOf(b)` (NOT b - a). Fix: in /app/frontend/src/pages/StudentResults.jsx around line 141-145, swap (b, a) to (a, b) — i.e., change `ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester)` to `ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester)`. Same logic the parent `ordered` already uses on line 25.

rca of the issue: Bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/StudentResults.jsx line ~140-145 in the semester-summary-card creates `[...ordered].sort((a, b) => ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester))`. ROMAN_ORDER is defined latest-first ([VIII, VII, VI, V, IV, III, II, I]) so lower index = LATER semester. The parent `ordered` (line 24-26) correctly does `indexOf(a) - indexOf(b)` which yields VII before I. The summary-card comparator is the OPPOSITE (b - a) which gives I before VII. Repro: log in as 220090170001 → /student/results → observe summary table rows = Sem I … Sem VII (oldest first). Detail cards below ARE correct (VII first). Mitigation (one-line fix): replace `ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester)` with `ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(a.semester) - ROMAN_ORDER.indexOf(b.semester)` (or simpler: drop the [...ordered].sort(...) wrapper and just iterate `ordered` directly since it is already latest-first).
